[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Spicy tuna roll recipe includes:  
- Ingredients for spicy tuna mixture: 1 can of sushi-grade tuna, 1/4 cup of mayonnaise, 1-2 teaspoons of sriracha sauce, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of chopped green onions, salt and pepper to taste.  
- Ingredients for sushi rice: 1 cup of short-grain Japanese rice, 1 3/4 cups of water, 1/4 cup of rice vinegar, 2 tablespoons of sugar, 1 teaspoon of salt.  
- Instructions for preparing sushi rice, mixing spicy tuna, assembling rolls, and serving suggestions.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for tonkotsu ramen broth, including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Tonkotsu ramen broth recipe includes:  
- Ingredients: 2 pounds of pork bones, 4 cups of water, 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, 1 onion, 2 cloves of garlic, 1 piece of ginger, 1 tablespoon of grated daikon (optional), 1 star anise, 2 cloves, 1 tablespoon of sake, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 teaspoon of sugar, salt to taste.  
- Instructions for roasting pork bones, caramelizing onion, adding ingredients, simmering, and straining the broth.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been experimenting with different broths and noodles at home and recently discovered a rich tonkotsu broth with springy noodles and crispy garlic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided recommendations for ramen toppings and sides, including:  
- Classic toppings: sliced pork (chashu), soft-boiled egg (ajitama), green onions (negi), pickled ginger (gari).  
- Modern twists: crispy garlic, spicy miso paste, grilled pork belly, sesame seeds.  
- Sides: gyoza, edamame, hiyayakko (cold tofu), renkon (deep-fried lotus root).
